mechanics.fact: Freezer temperatures soared to 50C as the hack flipped cooling to heating
mechanics.mechanic: Synchronized heat-flip gates in two shapes — full-height gap beams plus a low heat-band tunnel on the split's low road — share one broadcast clock (1400ms hot / 1400ms cold, all flip simultaneously), the coils themselves the tell; melt drips intensify per aisle as the freezers fail

mechanics.fact: Obsolete control systems with internet-exposed interfaces were exploited remotely
mechanics.mechanic: Hacked Defroster drones (freezer-fan units with glowing heater coils) patrol every aisle on x/y lanes; the seized machines are placed mid-route where the player must cross their lanes

mechanics.fact: 10 countries hit, shelves emptied, restock crews replenishing stores
mechanics.mechanic: Split-ridge supply chain: trunk gate, then a low band-tunnel road versus a high drone-ridge road rejoining at the gantry, then the roof control-room crown; checkpoints are restock depots and each act escalates with its own adds

mechanics.fact: Belgium hardest-hit with dozens of stores failing at once
mechanics.mechanic: Beamless guard vault: the worst-hit store's coils are dead (cooling restored), so the crown grab is a clean walk past the patrolling vault guard under alternating melt lines — pressure without timing luck
